daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are hitting different today. You're channeling that organized Virgo energy but with a creative twist—trust your gut when it whispers something new. The universe is lowkey rooting for your glow-up.
daily.love: Your authenticity is the main character energy right now. Whether you're single or coupled up, being real about what you actually want opens doors. Someone's noticing the shift in your frequency—let them.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is about to pay off in ways you didn't expect. A conversation or small win today plants seeds for something bigger. Stay curious and don't dismiss what feels like a random opportunity.
daily.health: Your body's asking you to slow down just a bit. Nothing dramatic—maybe move differently today, hydrate extra, or just give yourself permission to rest without the guilt. Sustainable energy beats burnout every time.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing this week, Virgo. You're channeling clearer thoughts and sharper intuition. Trust those random moments of clarity—they're not accidents. Time to organize your energy and see what actually matters to you rn.
weekly.love: Your vibe is magnetic but also kinda introspective. If you're coupled up, have real conversations. Single? Stop overthinking every interaction. Someone's noticing your quiet confidence, and honestly, that's the whole move.
weekly.career: Your detail-oriented nature is your superpower this week. Ideas are flowing, but don't get lost in perfectionism. Take one solid action toward something you've been thinking about. Progress over perfection, always.
weekly.health: Your nervous system could use some grounding. Try moving your body in ways that feel good, not punishing. A walk, stretching, dancing—whatever makes you feel present. Your energy responds when you're intentional about self-care.
